Pe neașteptate insă, Peyton reintacirc;lnește un vechi prieten, Finn, fost campion la inot, actual agent FBI, căruia ii cere ajutorul. Lucrurile se complică și mai mult atunci cacirc;nd Peyton și surorile ei moștenesc Bishop's Cove, un complex turistic de lux, situat pe malul oceanului. This captivating mystery novel from **Litera** plunges readers into a high-stakes scenario where professional ambitions collide with dangerous personal desires. If you love deep character development, perfect blends of comedy, and intense romance, this book is your next must-read romantic suspense gem.

Peyton Lockhart, a talented gastronomist, returns home after spending time studying at a prestigious culinary school in France. Her professional life takes an immediate turn toward the spotlight when she accepts a position with a renowned profile magazine. However, her career is thrown into chaos by her manipulative chef boss, who threatens her with sexual misconduct.

As Peyton struggles to survive professionally and personally, she realizes she could become a victimâa target used by someone desperate to avoid scandal. Unexpectedly, she reconnects with an old friend: Finn. Now an FBI agent and former swimming champion, Finn offers his help, drawing Peyton into a web of danger even thicker than she anticipated.

The stakes rise dramatically when both Peyton and her sisters inherit Bishop's Cove, a luxurious coastal tourist complex. The condition attached to this inheritance? They must manage the property and generate profit within one year. But managing the estate is not their only challenge; as life continues to complicate itself, Peyton finds herself falling for Finnâthe very man who could save her life, but also jeopardize her heart.

Will she find the safety and stability she has lost, and more importantly, the deep love she has always dreamed of?
